description: Buying-intent category queries for consumer mobile and web apps. No brand names: the brand under test either appears in the answer or it does not.

prompts.text: What's the best budgeting app for couples who share expenses?
Which meditation apps are worth paying for?
What's the best app for learning Spanish as a complete beginner?

What are the best fitness apps for working out at home without equipment?

Which apps help me track my sleep without a wearable?
What are the best free apps for planning a trip with friends?
Which to-do list apps have the cleanest design?
What's the best app for scanning and organizing receipts?
Which parental control apps work well for young kids?
What are the best meal planning apps for a family on a budget?

brandsNote: Lexicon for competitor extraction. Empty: no lexicon has been built for this vertical yet, and no brand names are invented here. A name matches case-insensitively at word boundaries, using the name plus any aliases. Entries marked ambiguous are common English words and only count in a name-like position (bold, a heading or a list-item label).
